name: Keo dua Thoi Son
summary: Handmade coconut candy, sold beside the honey as one of Thới Sơn’s OCOP products.
howToEat: Try a piece at the garden stop, with the tea.
where: Cù lao Thới Sơn. Cồn Phụng, the Ben Tre islet across the river, makes coconut candy too.
seoDescription: Kẹo dừa, the handmade coconut candy sold with the honey on Thới Sơn.
